pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at edges. Spatial area is larger on the mid-flank compared to the cervical and pectoral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly continuous network of light pelage. Junction nodes predominantly show tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section, narrowing slightly towards the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a low-amplitude serrated profile along the upper neck and shoulder area, visible as a jagged silhouette against the background.
